bar: The name files quarterly reports only, and it is pre-revenue with no consensus. The bar is the company's own statements. US$14m cash at 30 June 2026 (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260820/pdf/072znl4kwlvsk4.pdf, citing the 24 July 2026 quarterly). About US$154m of identified equity against a US$135m requirement. Lender term sheets and credit approvals targeted by the end of September 2026, FID in Q4 2026 (same document). Remaining senior debt of about US$280m after BNDES (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260909/pdf/073wk10btxggl4.pdf). The runway is no longer a live question: the placement settled on 27 August and OneIM filed a 9.90% substantial holding on 2026-09-01.
filer_type_check: quarterly_report_only. The ASX archive for 2024-2026 shows only Appendix 5B quarterlies, a Half Yearly Report on 13/03/2026, and an annual report each September (20/09/2024 18:22 and 24/09/2025 18:09). The 2026-09-24 amc row matches the annual-report slot, and the baseline classifier does not count that kind of filing. So instead of EPS I hunted cash and funding against runway, the debt-process timetable, placement overhang and holder changes.
event_check: Not confirmable before lodgement, and ASX issuers do not lodge a forward notice for an annual report. The 2026 archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=VMM&timeframe=Y&year=2026) runs to 16/09/2026 and holds no results-date notice. The 16/09/2026 AGM notice (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260916/pdf/0745frjqjp6fng.pdf) sets the AGM for 4 November 2026 and director nominations closing 23 September. The event is likely: the statutory deadline for the annual report is 30 September, and in 2025 it went out on the same calendar date after the close (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=VMM&timeframe=Y&year=2025). Any day from 24 to 30 September is possible, though, and it is a reporting event rather than a profit or cash-flow print. I set this to false because it is unconfirmed, not because it is known to be a phantom.
session_check: amc is consistent with the issuer's own history: 24/09/2025 18:09 and 20/09/2024 18:22 Sydney, both after the 16:00 close (ASX archive, 2025 and 2024 pages). The date itself is not settled.

At about 1.8m shares this is not crowded, so there is no squeeze fuel and no sign of shorts building. The priced lean of +1.3 comes mostly from the -13.6% 20-day run-up. The name has also lagged rare-earth peers this week: 5-day +0.9% against LYC +6.0%, BRE +14.9%, MEI +14.7% and ARU +12.1% (Yahoo chart, 2026-09-23). Part of the likely reason is visible: 31.1m placement shares issued at A$3.79 on 27/28 August sit underwater at A$3.55. That is overhang, not an event-window fact.

outside_window.finding: Target of lender term sheets and progression of credit approvals by the end of September 2026, ahead of a Q4 2026 FID. Receipt, most likely announced on its own rather than inside the annual report, would be a financing de-risk. A slip would come quietly, since the annual report can restate the target as Q4. The target is public and nothing dates it to 25 September.

OneIM Tranche 2 (about A$44.8m) is priced at the higher of A$3.70 and min(A$4.50, 90% of the 10-day VWAP). With spot at A$3.55 the A$3.70 floor binds above market. It needs FIRB clearance, due diligence and shareholder approval, and the approval route is the 4 November AGM. Whether OneIM completes above market is an AGM-date question.
